title: Wheel Mobile Raku Demonstrations and Activities
source_quote: Union Project's Wheel Mobile is equipped with clay, tools, a potter's wheel, and a Raku kiln.
evidence_sentence: The homepage states the Wheel Mobile is equipped with a raku kiln and offers raku firing demonstrations.
evidence_quote: Union Project's Wheel Mobile is equipped with clay, tools, a potter's wheel, and a Raku kiln.
summary: The Wheel Mobile brings raku firing demonstrations and activities to communities throughout Pittsburgh and beyond. Teaching artists provide wheel throwing, hand-building, and raku firing demonstrations at playgrounds, festivals, and libraries.
how_to_join: Contact Union Project to arrange Wheel Mobile visit to your location
